messages:
Ellie (Design): Quick mock — thinking of moving the main ‘Export’ dropdown into the trace viewer header so it’s more discoverable. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/trace-export-mock.png
TJ (Eng Runtime): +1. Right now export lives under the kebab and people miss it.
Sam (Product): One question: what exactly does the dropdown export? raw spans JSON vs CSV vs just stack traces? we should make that explicit in the copy.
Ellie (Design): Proposed copy for the dropdown entries (WIP):
```
Export traces
- Full JSON (raw spans)
- Pretty CSV (aggregate by request)
- Compact stacktrace (for sharing)
```
Mia (Accessibility): A11y nits: the control needs aria-label="Export trace" and must be reachable before the share/menu items in tab order. Also ensure role=menu and proper focus trapping for keyboard users.
TJ (Eng Runtime): Implementation note: generating a Pretty CSV is an extra transform. Might be slow for large traces — propose async export: user clicks, we show a toast + link when ready.
Sam (Product): Rename suggestion: "Compact stacktrace" -> "Stacktrace (compact) for debugging" — more explicit than "for sharing".
Carlos (Support): Also really want a quick correlation-ID copy affordance next to the trace title. Support gets that ID in tickets 90% of the time.
Ellie (Design): Thinking a small pill next to title: "CorrID: abc123" with a copy icon. Tooltip on hover. Should the tooltip read "Copy correlation ID" or "Copy span id"? which do we standardize on?
Mia (Accessibility): Use the full phrase for screen readers: aria-label="Copy correlation identifier". Visual tooltip can be shorter. Make sure the icon button has an accessible name and keyboard focus.
TJ (Eng Runtime): Also consider making exported filenames include the corr id and timestamp, e.g., trace-abc123-20240312.csv for easy matching.
Sam (Product): UX nit: moving the chevron to the far right reduces accidental clicks. Also prefer the primary quick action "Download JSON" for advanced users and a secondary "Export" dropdown for formats.
Kendall (QA): Please add tests for keyboard traversal, NVDA screen reader text, and exported filename pattern.
Sam (Product): I'll update the PR with copy tweaks and create a ticket for async export + permalink behavior. Assigning @TJ for implementation work and @Mia for an a11y review. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: build #4921 passed on main
Ellie (Design): Thanks — leaving updated mock and component spec in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd-export-header
TJ (Eng Runtime): I'll scope the async job and add perf guardrails (max traces per export / sampling).
Mia (Accessibility): I can review the a11y test plan tomorrow morning.
Carlos (Support): +1 on corr id pill — would save a lot of back-and-forth.
Ellie (Design): Closing for now unless anyone objects. Will push final copy into the PR shortly.
